email.passwordReset.subject: OnScreen — Password Reset
email.passwordReset.heading: Reset Your Password
email.passwordReset.body: Hi {username}, we received a request to reset your password. Click the button below to choose a new one. This link expires in 1 hour.
email.passwordReset.footer: If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.
email.invite.subject: You're invited to OnScreen
email.invite.heading: You've Been Invited
email.invite.body: {inviter} has invited you to join their OnScreen media server. Click below to set up your account.
email.invite.footer: If you weren't expecting this, you can safely ignore this email.
email.test.subject: OnScreen — SMTP Test
email.test.heading: SMTP Configuration Works
email.test.body: If you're reading this, your OnScreen email configuration is working correctly.
email.test.footer: This is a test email sent from OnScreen.
email.digest.heading: New in {period}
email.digest.intro: Hi {username}, here's what was added to your libraries.
email.digest.introEmpty: Hi {username}, nothing new was added to your libraries in {period}.
email.digest.textIntro: Here's what was added to your libraries in {period}.
email.digest.textEmpty: Nothing new was added to your libraries in {period}.
email.digest.footer.weekly: You're getting this because you turned on the weekly digest on your OnScreen account.
email.digest.footer.monthly: You're getting this because you turned on the monthly digest on your OnScreen account.
